page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 31.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.88 GB of RAM per core. Storage is bundled with a single local NVMe SSD offering 68 GB of capacity. No GPU resources are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core metrics, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression all ranking in the top 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as observed in multi-threaded stress-ng and bzip3 decompression benchmarks. Memory bandwidth remains in the middle tier, with read-only small block cached bandwidth measured at 843.94 GB/sec and uncached large block write bandwidth at 33.42 GB/sec.

This instance is well-suited for single-threaded processing tasks, lightweight database operations, and small-scale language model inference, where it achieves top-tier text generation speeds on 135M parameter models. Conversely, it exhibits weak performance in prompt processing for medium-sized 7B models, making it less suitable for larger LLM workloads. The dedicated AMD EPYC hardware profile offers high single-core efficiency, though the limited 68 GB local SSD capacity and lack of GPU acceleration restrict its use to general-purpose compute, web serving, and basic data compression pipelines.
